_doc: Priorities from client-usage.md table surfaces; unused=skip. Done means covered by real Connection tests. Partial notes list known limits.

assets.createUrl.note: Tested: attachment, workspace-file (incl. HTML dependency grants), media-file (identity-pinned), draft-workspace-file, project-favicon (+missing sentinel). GET /api/assets/* streams, supports Range/HEAD, rejects traversal/forged/expired tokens. tool-output-image is implemented but untested; native-app-icon and github-media are refused; mcp-app HTML injection not done.

assets.persistChatAttachments.note: No client call site in inventory.

attachments.createUploadUrl.note: Real-client test (files_assets): HMAC-signed 10 min grant, type/size limits (10 MiB image, 50 MiB file), pending-<uuid>[-ext] ids. Token layout matches T3.

attachments.delete.note: Real-client test: removes pending uploads (and .txt sidecar), idempotent, ignores non-pending or malformed ids. Upload route: streamed to a .part file, exact size, 204, 409 on conflicting duplicate.

git.runStackedAction.note: Real-client stream test: commit, commit_push, push, commit_push_pr (with gh), featureBranch, filePaths subset, up-to-date and no-change results, action_failed with the failing phase, request validation, path confinement. Not done: hook_* events, generated commit messages, cancellation of a running step (an Interrupt stops sending events but the step finishes), PR creation without gh.

orchestration.getFullThreadDiff.note: Same as getTurnDiff: tested against seeded checkpoints; capture is not implemented.

orchestration.getThreadFamily.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.getThreadProjection.note: Real-client test: bounded projection (up to 100 rows per kind) and an error for unknown threads.

orchestration.getTurnDiff.note: Tested against seeded checkpoint records and real git refs (ranges, whitespace flag, unavailable turns, invalid refs and unknown workspaces refused). o3-server does not capture checkpoints yet, so no thread produces them.

orchestration.getTurnItem.note: Real-client test: item by id for its own thread, null otherwise. The revision argument is ignored.

orchestration.getWorktreeThreadIds.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.launchThread.note: Connection: idempotent root launch. Core tests: new git worktree, existing worktree, thread reuse and receipts. Atomic create+initial dispatch, workflow cleanup and reuse metadata semantics remain.

orchestration.searchThreadStream.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.searchThreads.note: Real-client test: SQLite FTS5 index kept by message writes and rebuilt when missing; best message per thread with hits/quality/snippet, prefix match, project filter, titlesOnly, archived/deleted excluded, FTS syntax inert. Not done: threads/olderSettled fields, environmentLabel.

orchestration.subscribeArchivedShell.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.subscribeShell.note: Real Connection snapshot/replay tests. SQLite streaming removes the 10,000 cap (10,002-project streaming test); omitIdleSubagents/omitOlderSettled and family shapes remain.

orchestration.subscribeThread.note: Real Connection tests: streamed full opt-out (140 messages), bounded ten-turn window, compact IDs/body dedupe/local turn-item omission, replay/markers. Generic/activity/oversized and targeted-history policies are not fully conformant.

Not done: repositoryIdentity, force-delete does not cascade to threads.

projects.readFile.note: Real-client test: relative paths rooted lexically and by realpath (symlink escapes refused), 1 MiB cap with truncated flag, binary refused, allowMissing, absolute host paths read in place as T3 does, filesystem:read scope.
